title: White Men Lead, Black Women Help? Benchmarking and Mitigating Language Agency Social Biases in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate biographies, professor reviews, and reference letters using male and female descriptors/names, then using a BERT-based classifier to categorize sentences as 'agentic' or 'communal' to measure the gap in language agency attributed to different genders.

Prompting LLMs to generate text using race-specific names and descriptors for White, Black, Hispanic, and Asian groups, classifying the generated sentences as 'agentic' or 'communal', and comparing the relative agency level variances across these racial demographics.

Evaluating language agency discrepancies by prompting LLMs with combined gender and racial descriptors (e.g., Black female vs. White male) to measure compounding biases in how agentic versus communal language is applied to intersectional minority groups.
